core_result: Along x=0 the timing-record uncertainty falls 3 -> 1.5 -> 0 bits only when the corresponding seed events enter the observer's causal past.
same_time_observer_dependence: At t=2, x=0 has Y+S0 while x=2 has Y+S1; both retain 1.5 bits but possess different decrypting side information.
boundary: Finite 1+1D causal toy model; no claim that physical horizons are cryptographic ciphers or that relativity creates fundamental randomness.
